rules.agreement: number of research CIOs (A, C) whose recorded direction for the same stock and horizon matches; not a probability
rules.display_pct: 100 x recorded directional probability (UP: p_up; DOWN: 1 - p_up), rounded half-up
rules.most_pick: CIO-A or CIO-C F-DIR record of the latest base, UP or DOWN, F&O in scope, recorded probability of its direction >= 0.55, company not PRICE-ONLY in that CIO's pack, evidence citing a forward-institution record id (FI|...)
rules.price_signals: CIO-B only (never institutional): F&O in scope, UP or DOWN, recorded probability >= 0.55, strict order: probability desc, horizon asc, stock asc
rules.ranking: recorded probability desc; then research CIOs (A, C) in the same direction on the same stock and horizon desc; then horizon asc; then stock asc; then CIO (A before C). Rank 1 is the MOST PICK
rules.result: settled outcome only (matured window): base-session open to the close of session base+h-1, split/bonus adjusted; ABSTAIN is not a call
